fields.statement: Verified at 7ce66901a in a detached checkout. Re-ran the commit's Checks: block and the acceptance, all exit 0: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'GuideInstall|SkillFile|Plugin|Status' (TestGuideInstallRoleSkills checks that rhiza-builder, rhiza-verifier and rhiza-build-retry SKILL.md are the frontmatter with the topic's description plus the expanded body, and that a second install reports them unchanged); go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... (TestBuildIsAnIndex checks that build names builder, verifier and build-retry by their /skill and `rhiza guide` routes and stays under 250 tokens); go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(guide|guide-install|build-evidence-commit|status|docs-commands-exist)$' (guide ls has the three topics, install output lists the new skill paths with 10 written, and build-evidence-commit's fake builder greps `rhiza guide builder`); rhiza ship generate, rhiza render (tree clean afterwards) and make self-check. Read the diff: guide_install.go writes the three skills beside the others, build.md is a short index saying which role loads which topic, the only log entries staged are the builder's own actor record, and no stubs or TODOs.
